hard_rule: METADATA-ONLY. MUST NOT carry raw .usdc body/binary or any large model/3D bytes; metadata references such as usdc_ref are allowed; large artifacts stay on the customer edge (PDF cloud-edge separation).

open_question_status.OQ1: company cloud callback endpoint URL + auth (machine token? mTLS?) TBD by external platform team
open_question_status.OQ2: source/usdc artifact ref scheme (minio:// naming, etag source) TBD
open_question_status.mitigation: this frozen contract is the T5.4 stand-in; real endpoint stays 'pending' until OQ1 is confirmed; outbox/retry/dead-letter is verified against this fixture, not a live cloud

example.reason: converter_failed: USDC could not be opened

delivery_semantics.callback_status_field: callback delivery state is reported separately from conversion success; conversion_job stays 'ready' locally even if callback not yet acked
delivery_semantics.outbox: callback retained in callback_outbox and retried per policy when cloud unreachable (network/5xx/timeout)
delivery_semantics.dead_letter: after retries exhausted -> dead_letter state with evidence (target URL, attempts, last error, correlation_id); never silently dropped
delivery_semantics.forbidden: no raw .usdc body/binary / no large bytes in payload (metadata refs such as usdc_ref are allowed)
